spec.scope: 08:00 Europe/London through NY POST; all three literal WLR colors
spec.warmup: Consecutive closed M15 history may include NIGHT before PRE; segment A begins at/after 08:00 Europe/London. European opening candle 0 is eligible at its close when history is ready.
spec.decision: first eligible closed-bar snapshot per color segment

v2.sourceLimit: All historical windows were previously inspected. Exploratory retrospective comparison; forward evaluation begins 2026-10-22. Do not tune from test or forward outcomes.

directionForecast.anchor: Last closed WLR centerline at issue, frozen; not OHLC close or future end of A
directionForecast.baseline: Causal majority among completed same-color/phase historical days; one closest eligible case per day; no test-majority oracle
directionForecast.selection: Keep original validation-MAE-selected model; additional exploratory direction evaluation, no test winner selection

publication: Experimental web publication explicitly authorized by user on 2026-10-21; no established price edge

protocol.color: Exact existing WLR priceMid phase color: agreement of original-volume SPY V and Composite adjusted Strength. Green +1, red -1, yellow 0. Independent of candle cluster colors.
protocol.median: Median of existing WLR50 centerline values in the segment; not median close, regression slope or channel center. Current anchor uses only known prefix of current A.
protocol.sequence: Exactly A-B-A. Three literal colors; A-B-C-A is broken, no neutral bridging or post-test min-length merging. Segments confined to contiguous NY Europe-open-to-POST frame. First frame segment is left-truncated; its known prefix is explicit.
protocol.target: Full next-A WLR median within one Europe-open-through-POST daily frame. Membership is confirmed as soon as next A appears after exactly one B; next A need not finish. Median is scored only after that next A ends causally. Completion8 requires its ending confirmation within next8 bars and before frame end.
protocol.warmup: Consecutive closed M15 history may include NIGHT before PRE; segment A begins at/after 08:00 Europe/London. European opening candle 0 is eligible at its close when history is ready.
protocol.coverage: One earliest eligible closed-bar query per WLR segment throughout EURO/PRE/RTH/POST. Include all three colors equally and retain every pending/unfinished sample for prediction. An unfinished next A is a confirmed member without a final median. Unseen third segment at POST end is unconfirmed, not a failed membership label. Pending current sessions remain in a separate prediction ledger with null outcomes and no fabricated losses.
protocol.causal: No final current-A median/end/length in features. Historical labels mature at POST close before the new 16-bar input begins. Match same literal color and decision phase; select at most one candidate per historical day. All intraday test queries are aggregated into paired day means before bootstrap; N queries is not N independent days.
protocol.models: Current known A median, last completed same-color median, all mature color-cohort median delta, original ten-channel STUMPY8/16, then fixed 80% STUMPY squared distance +20% causal cycle-context squared distance. No outcome tuning of weights.
protocol.twoStage: Keep provisional membership predictions for unfinished samples. pMembership is descriptive among resolved historical memberships, with unresolved count and bounds; no unfinished case is relabeled negative. pEvent/pEvent8 separately estimate full median completion inside the frame and within8. Conditional price estimate uses only completed historical targets; >=12 distinct target days, otherwise current-median fallback. One pseudo-count per class; no calibrated-confidence claim.
protocol.selection: Trial selection uses validation price MAE only if >=10 common ready target days, else WAIT/no chosen trial. Keep Jul17 validation and Aug21 final-test boundaries from preceding work. Test metrics are descriptive when selector WAIT.
protocol.limits: Previously inspected archive; this new target has not been forward validated. Variable event timing cannot honestly be drawn as a fixed eight-point price path. No website promotion. Paired circular five-day bootstrap,5000 draws,97.5% intervals; >=30 target days required.

v3.sourceLimit: Previously inspected historical archive. Six-week gate is exploratory development data; historical holdout is descriptive. Only post-freeze dates can be future evaluation.

liveLimit: Historical scores concern first eligible segment snapshots, including European opening candle 0 using preceding closed history when ready. An already-open segment may be selected for a new causal live forecast; that later entry has not been separately forward validated.
